profile: Optional larger model: ARM64 CPU inference on the pinned runtime's 8192-token context; qwen35 architecture, the same family and chat template as the 2B; 3.0 GB artifact. It needs about 3.5 GB resident, because llama.cpp keeps a 2.7 GB repacked copy of the weights besides the mapped file, plus 0.58 GB of context and compute buffers, so the app offers and loads it only on phones reporting at least 7,000,000,000 bytes of memory (8 GB class). On a Redmi 13C (6 GB) llama-bench read 6.6-7.3 and wrote 2.3 tokens/s against 16-17.5 and 5.2-5.45 for the 2B, so answers take about 2.5 times as long, but Android killed the app 0.2 s after the model loaded in it; an Infinix X6840 (4 GB) was killed twice and then rebooted. Not yet run on an 8 GB phone
